Noto Serif Hebrew from github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notoserifhebrew (variable font).
Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors (https://github.com/notofonts/hebrew). SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL.txt).
Bundled as composeApp/src/commonMain/composeResources/font/noto_serif_hebrew_{regular,semibold}.ttf: static
instances (weight 400 and 600, width 100) cut from the variable font with fontTools' instancer. It covers Hebrew
letters, vowel points and every cantillation mark, which the word-study screens use to show Hebrew headwords.
